name: Sunita Devi
quote: Before the group I had never held my own savings. Today I run a small tailoring shop and my daughters are in school. Janak ji and his team simply believed we could do it.

name: Rakesh Thapa
quote: My son was about to leave school to work. The evening class and the scholarship kept him in. He now wants to become a teacher.

name: Dr. Meera Nair
quote: I have worked with many organisations. This one is unusual: the follow-up is real, and the community is in charge.

name: Arjun Rai
quote: They did not arrive with answers. They asked what we needed, then stayed to see it done.

name: Pooja Sharma
quote: Clear reports, honest numbers and visible results. It is easy to trust Sangharsh with our CSR funds.
